scripts.dev: bun run build:web && bun run src/index.ts serve
scripts.build:web: bun build src/web/client/main.ts --outdir src/web/dist --minify --target browser --entry-naming app.js && cp src/web/client/index.html src/web/dist/index.html && cp src/web/client/app.css src/web/dist/app.css
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --minify src/index.ts --outfile ../dist/wohnung
scripts.build:native: bun run build:web && bun build --compile --minify src/index.ts --outfile ../dist/wohnung-native
